description: v0.5's EI specialist, s9_ei_wavg (its one run: raw probabilities averaged, then its own calibration, temperature)

settings.resampling: articles (group.pmcid), sorted by PMCID as text, every prompt of a drawn article kept (compare_session8.py); each input over its own articles, the time-point subset over its own, title minus none over the articles of the prompts in both inputs, the same draws for both
settings.answer: the argmax of the calibrated probabilities

none.probabilities: the runs' raw probabilities averaged (1 run), then s9_ei_wavg's calibration (temperature); on the full input, the raw probabilities of the one file given, then the same calibration

title.probabilities: the runs' raw probabilities averaged (1 run), then s9_ei_wavg's calibration (temperature); on the full input, the raw probabilities of the one file given, then the same calibration

swap.probabilities: the runs' raw probabilities averaged (1 run), then s9_ei_wavg's calibration (temperature); on the full input, the raw probabilities of the one file given, then the same calibration

time_point_or_baseline.rule: the comparator of the prompt as written (the exchanged record's intervention) matches TIME_POINT, ignoring case; the subset's own articles resampled

title_minus_none.prompts: the prompts in both inputs (every title prompt)
title_minus_none.difference_reading: higher with the title than with no article
title_minus_none.excludes: title minus none in macro-F1 is 0.094, with a 95 percent interval of 0.066 to 0.123: the interval excludes a difference below 0.066 and one above 0.123; it excludes zero; it excludes 0.05 (below the interval)

none.reading: its answers depend on the article's text
none.from: macro-F1 with no article, its estimate
none.rule: macro-F1 with no article (its estimate) at or below 0.60: "its answers depend on the article's text"; above 0.75: "the prompt alone carries more than a classifier trained on prompts alone (0.511 macro-F1, DeYoung et al. 2020, Table 1); it may come from EI's training prompts (a model of 4 billion parameters may learn stronger priors from them than that classifier did), from pretraining, or from EI's public labels, and these checks cannot tell them apart"; otherwise "partly"

title.reading: the title adds information about the result: a title can state the result, or the model may recall the trial, and these checks cannot tell them apart
title.from: the 95 percent interval of the paired difference in macro-F1, title minus none
title.rule: the 95 percent interval of the paired difference in macro-F1, title minus none: wholly above 0.05: "the title adds information about the result: a title can state the result, or the model may recall the trial, and these checks cannot tell them apart"; wholly below 0.05: "no added knowledge of 0.05 or more was detected"; otherwise "not settled"

swap.from: accuracy against the exchanged answers, its estimate
swap.rule: accuracy against the exchanged answers (its estimate) at or above 0.85: "it follows the comparison as written"; below 0.70: "it does not follow the exchange (recall of the trial or a bias toward one direction)"; otherwise "partly"

stop_rule: the stop applies to s8_ei only

prior.text: the training split's answer shares score a macro-F1 of 0.198 on the test split (0.185 to 0.210)
prior.source: results/fiorillo_v0_4/comparison.json, metrics > evidence_effect > prior > macro_f1 (session 8's comparisons; no prediction file is read here)
